claims.title: Coherent completion makes energy descent exact while locality and finite-window escape govern preparation

status: Source-derived arguments and inspected producer replay; new extensions separately identified as integration-derived.
interface: Finite-dimensional supplied-H downward-filtered jump completion with exact all-state energy monotonicity, separate acquired-control reductions and explicit slow/trapped examples. New approximate local-rigidity, strict local-minimum and finite-window escape results have their own proofs. Exact faithful-Schmidt local-channel rigidity has established prior art and is credited as known.
limits: Externally review the completion, robust local bound and finite-window equivalence. Acquire legal finite-time filters/correction/support with rigorous generator errors, and a useful global or compressed finite-window escape certificate including conditioning and all inverse/control/reset costs. Compare preparation with known Gibbs/ground-state samplers and direct coherent controls on a consequential supplied physical task; a monotonicity identity alone does not close preparation.
